newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Deutsche M. Grenfell recommends Russian Vimpelcom.
newsitem.headline: Deutsche M. Grenfell recommends Russian Vimpelcom.

text.p: Deutsche Morgan Grenfell said it recommended buying shares in mobile telecoms operator Vimpelcom (Vympelkom in Russian).
Vimpelcom was a buy at $35.50, the price registered on January 29, it said in a research note by analyst Ruth Belbin.
Vimpelcom American Depositary Shares closed at $31-3/8 at the New York Stock Exchange on Monday, down from $33-3/8 on Friday. The stock was traded at $23 at the year end.
Deutsche Morgan Grenfell said Vimpelcom remains an attractive stock due to its quick growth and good prospects.
"The company's current growth rate and outlook remain impressive, and we still consider Vimpelcom undervalued," it said.
Earnings per share are likely to rise 65 percent to $3.88 in 1997 from $2.37 in 1996, putting underlying shares on a price/earnings multiple for 1996 of 19.9.
It attributed the recent fall in Vimpelcom's ADS price to a growth in the issue of new cellular licences in the Moscow region, which created considerable competition to the company.
However, any new entrant to the market will have to assail the firm grip of Vimpelcom's Beeline trademark, which holds about 60 percent of the market, it said.
"In the medium term we are confident that Vimpelcom will remain the leading cellular provider in the key market of Moscow and the surrounding region," it said.
